hooks.command: bash -c 'staged=$(git diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null); if echo "$staged" | grep -qE "PIPELINE_MODULES_PATTERN"; then if ! echo "$staged" | grep -qE "\.(test|spec)\."; then echo "PIPELINE MODULE CHANGED WITHOUT TESTS. Staged pipeline files:"; echo "$staged" | grep -E "PIPELINE_MODULES_PATTERN"; echo ""; echo "Commit checklist requires: write the failing test FIRST for these modules."; echo "Stage a test file, or use git commit with --no-verify if you have a reason."; exit 1; fi; fi'
hooks._comment: Replace PIPELINE_MODULES_PATTERN with a regex matching your project's data pipeline modules. Example for SENDEX: (classification|findings_|derive-summaries|cross-domain-syndromes|syndrome-interpretation|findings-rail-engine|recovery-classification|finding-nature|protective-signal|lab-clinical-catalog)

hooks.command: bash -c 'REPO_ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if [ -f "$REPO_ROOT/.lattice/engine-changed" ]; then if [ ! -f "$REPO_ROOT/.lattice/validation-compared" ]; then echo "ENGINE FILES WERE MODIFIED but validation ratchet was not run."; echo ""; echo "Run: bash scripts/validation-ratchet.sh auto"; echo "Or:  bash scripts/validation-ratchet.sh compare  (if you already regenerated)"; echo ""; echo "This ensures analytical behavior changes are detected and documented."; echo "If validation degrades, the ratchet will tell you what changed and why."; exit 1; fi; fi'
hooks._comment: Enforce validation ratchet when engine files changed. The .lattice/engine-changed marker is set by the PostToolUse engine-change hook. The .lattice/validation-compared marker is set by validation-ratchet.sh compare. Both are cleared after commit.

hooks.command: bash -c 'REPO_ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$REPO_ROOT" ] && [ -f "$REPO_ROOT/scripts/context-meter.sh" ]; then bash "$REPO_ROOT/scripts/context-meter.sh"; fi'
hooks._comment: Context pressure meter. Tracks cumulative file reads per session. Warns at 80K tokens (HIGH) and 150K tokens (CRITICAL). Reset .lattice/session-context to 0 at session start.

hooks.command: bash -c 'if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q "Co-Authored-By"; then echo "BLOCKED: CLAUDE.md rule 5 -- never add Claude as co-author."; exit 1; fi'

bash -c 'FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -oP '"file_path"\s*:\s*"\K[^"]+' 2>/dev/null || echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$FILE" ] && [ -f "$FILE" ]; then REPO_ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$REPO_ROOT" ] && [ -f "$REPO_ROOT/scripts/complexity-check.sh" ]; then bash "$REPO_ROOT/scripts/complexity-check.sh" "$FILE"; fi; fi'
hooks._comment: Post-edit complexity spot-check. Advisory warnings only.

hooks.command: bash -c 'FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -oP '"file_path"\s*:\s*"\K[^"]+' 2>/dev/null || true); if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE "ENGINE_FILES_PATTERN"; then REPO_ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); mkdir -p "$REPO_ROOT/.lattice"; touch "$REPO_ROOT/.lattice/engine-changed"; rm -f "$REPO_ROOT/.lattice/validation-compared" 2>/dev/null; echo "ENGINE FILE MODIFIED: $(basename $FILE)"; echo "Validation ratchet will be required before commit."; echo "Run: bash scripts/validation-ratchet.sh auto"; fi'
hooks._comment: Engine change detection — sets marker that triggers pre-commit validation gate. Replace ENGINE_FILES_PATTERN with your project's engine file regex. Advisory message but the PreToolUse commit hook is the enforcer.

_setup._comment: Customize these patterns for your project:
_setup.PIPELINE_MODULES_PATTERN: Regex for data pipeline modules that require test-first discipline
_setup.ENGINE_FILES_PATTERN: Regex for engine/analytical files that require validation ratchet
